views.name: category_sales
views.definition:
SELECT o.created_at::date AS sale_date,
    c.name AS category_name,
    sum(oi.quantity) AS items_sold,
    sum(oi.subtotal) AS revenue
   FROM order_items oi
     JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
     JOIN menu_items mi ON mi.id = oi.menu_item_id
     JOIN categories c ON c.id = mi.category_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'::order_status
  GROUP BY (o.created_at::date), c.name
  ORDER BY (o.created_at::date) DESC, (sum(oi.subtotal)) DESC;

views.name: daily_sales
views.definition:
SELECT created_at::date AS sale_date,
    count(*) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(sum(total_amount), 0::numeric) AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(avg(total_amount), 0::numeric) AS avg_order_value,
    COALESCE(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'::payment_method), 0::numeric) AS cash_sales,
    COALESCE(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'gcash'::payment_method), 0::numeric) AS gcash_sales,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'dine-in'::order_type) AS dinein_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'takeout'::order_type) AS takeout_count,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_type = 'delivery'::order_type) AS delivery_count
   FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'completed'::order_status
  GROUP BY (created_at::date)
  ORDER BY (created_at::date) DESC;

functions.name: decrement_stock
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decrement_stock()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  update public.inventory
  set stock_count = greatest(stock_count - new.quantity, 0)
  where menu_item_id = new.menu_item_id
    and track_inventory = true;
  return new;
end;
$function$

 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''

$function$

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, email, full_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    new.email,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', '')
  );
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: restore_stock_on_cancel
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.restore_stock_on_cancel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  if old.status != 'cancelled' and new.status = 'cancelled' then
    update public.inventory inv
    set stock_count = inv.stock_count + oi.quantity
    from public.order_items oi
    where oi.order_id = new.id
      and inv.menu_item_id = oi.menu_item_id
      and inv.track_inventory = true;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
